release_notes: The SSL-and-lead-integrity release. Four audited bugs fixed plus the domain workflow rebuilt end to end. SSL Bug 1: incomplete_chain stops conflating a broken chain with an unreadable file — on root-only /etc/letsencrypt hosts the panel read 0 blocks for a healthy certificate, marked it failed and fed the retry backoff for nothing. The verdict is now three-state (ok / incomplete_chain / chain_unreadable); unreadable means installed-with-warning, never failed; existence checks and chain reads work through the web user via sudoers-scoped helpers; the re-issue button really re-issues (sudo certbot delete with the exit code checked + --force-renewal, replacing an rm -rf that could only fail silently); migration 41 resets the falsely-failed backoff. SSL automation: parking a domain now issues its certificate before the save response returns (the old background attempt fired into /dev/null, died on database contention and left the panel green over a self-signed response); the worker runs every 5 minutes instead of hourly and is flock-guarded against certbot lock collisions; bulk pastes cap the synchronous run at 3 domains with a spinner instead of an apparent hang; the queue survives a locked SQLite database. LeadForge Bug 4: four networks were selectable with no send adapter and order.php fabricated a 200 OK without any request — silent lead loss. The fake success is gone (error logged, lead snapshot preserved in the CRM vault, visitor gets an honest error), the network selector is fed from the backend's single source of truth with a has_adapter flag (nothing unspeakable is buildable), a real AdCombo adapter ships, and the selector gains a My affiliate networks group from the Affiliate Networks tab with endpoint prefill and built-in adapter suggestions. Privacy Bug 2: the scan-protection settings actually save now (they were silently dropped by both whitelist spots while the API answered success), unknown settings keys fail loudly, and the protection itself works — an unknown alias answers with the operator's chosen 302/404/blank instead of the tracker-signature "Campaign not found.". Bug 3 + the Domains page rebuild: custom-SSL fields reachable, the table joins the centred fixed-layout system, the toolbar and the Add-Domain modal restructured. Installer: opens 80/443 in ufw when active, schedules the SSL worker every 5 minutes, and ships cli/ssl_diagnose.sh — a read-only one-shot that separates a truncated chain from an unreadable file on any server.
